**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation obligation on Sparkling. There is no pricing-parity covenant anywhere in the document — fees are fixed by reference to Schedule "A" only, and the maintenance provisions run in our favour (Garman-side service obligations). Our preferred position is already achieved.

Note for the negotiation record: an MFN *in our favour* (Garman granting Sparkling best pricing) would be welcome and could be raised affirmatively as a commercial ask, but its absence is not a deviation under this rule and does not warrant a defensive redline.
